music_rep_aero_grade_3: Nivo 3: 72 BPM, de nòt pa klik
music_rep_aero_grade_5: Nivo 5: 66 BPM, kat nòt pa klik

music_rep_aero_pair_first_palm: louvri rive nan premye kle pla men an
music_rep_aero_pair_left_pinky_b_bb: ti dwèt goch, soti B rive Bb
music_rep_aero_pair_left_pinky_cs_b: ti dwèt goch, soti C# rive B
music_rep_aero_pair_palm_stacking: kle pla men yo ap anpile
music_rep_aero_pair_right_pinky_eb_c: ti dwèt dwat, soti Eb rive C
music_rep_aero_slip_octave_up: kle oktav la pa t peze
music_rep_aero_tongue_slur2_tongue2: De lye, de ak kout lang
music_rep_aero_tongue_slur3_tongue1: Twa lye, youn ak kout lang
music_rep_aero_tongue_tongue2_slur2: De ak kout lang, de lye
music_rep_aero_vib_4_at_80: Kat pa tan a 80 (vitès abityèl la)
music_rep_jam_note_capo: Anrejistreman an nan {key}: mete kapo a sou frèt {fret}.
music_rep_jam_note_horse_with_no_name: Nan anrejistreman an, dezyèm akò a se D6/9 sou F#. Isit la, se yon D senp.
music_rep_jam_note_let_it_be: Nan anrejistreman an, akò a chanje chak de tan. Isit la, se youn pa mezi.
music_rep_jam_note_sweet_home_alabama: Anrejistreman an jwe C ak G nan yon sèl mezi, ak Cadd9. Isit la, se akò senp.
music_rep_jam_note_zombie: Anrejistreman an gen D sou F#. Isit la, se yon D senp.
music_rep_padrep_afrobeats_feel: Gwo kès sou 1 ak pouse sou & apre 2 ak 3. Rebò a reponn sou “a” apre 1 ak & apre 2 (3-3-2 la). Klap sou 2 ak 4, shaker an doub kwòch. Yon vèsyon kouran: pwodiktè yo chanje l.
music_rep_padrep_afrobeats_fingers: Men dwat sou doub kwòch shaker la (hi-hat). Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès, dwèt mitan goch sou rebò. Klap la ak konga a (tom wo) kote yo tonbe.
music_rep_padrep_amen_feel: Kat mezi: twazyèm nan fè dènye kès la vin an reta, katriyèm nan chanje tout bagay epi frape crash la.
music_rep_padrep_amen_fingers: Dwèt jouda dwat sou ride la. Dwèt jouda goch sou kès la ak nòt fantom yo, dwèt mitan goch sou gwo kès la.
music_rep_padrep_apache_feel: Kès la reponn tèt li sou & apre 3 ak “a” apre 4 (tempo apeprè).
music_rep_padrep_backbeat_feel: Gwo kès sou 1 ak 3, kès sou 2 ak 4.
music_rep_padrep_backbeat_fingers: Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès, dwèt jouda dwat sou kès.
music_rep_padrep_basic_rock_feel: Ritm ki anba mil chante (Billie Jean chita sou li a anviwon 117 BPM).
music_rep_padrep_blues_shuffle_feel: Hi-hat sou premye ak twazyèm nòt chak triyolè (long-kout shuffle la), gwo kès sou 1 ak 3, kès sou 2 ak 4.
music_rep_padrep_boom_bap_2bar_feel: De mezi. Dezyèm nan reponn premye a.
music_rep_padrep_boom_bap_a_feel: Dezyèm kou gwo kès la tonbe sou & apre 2: premye pouse a.
music_rep_padrep_boom_bap_b_feel: Gwo kès hip-hop klasik la: kat kou apre backbeat sou 2 a.
music_rep_padrep_bossa_nova_feel: Sourdo a sou gwo kès la (ti pouse dousman anvan 1 ak 3), ak klav bossa a sou cross-stick la sou de mezi.
music_rep_padrep_bossa_nova_fingers: Men dwat sou hi-hat la. Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès la, dwèt mitan goch sou rebò a. Pedal hi-hat la ak yon dwèt ki lib sou 2 ak 4.
music_rep_padrep_cold_sweat_feel: Funk Clyde Stubblefield la: backbeat la sou 2, dezyèm kès la pouse sou “a” apre 3, nòt fantom nan mitan. Pwovizwa: yon vèsyon pou aprann, konpare l ak anrejistreman an.
music_rep_padrep_cold_sweat_fingers: Men dwat sou hi-hat la. Dwèt jouda goch sou kès la ak nòt fantom li yo, dwèt mitan goch sou gwo kès la.
music_rep_padrep_cumbia_feel: Gwacharaka a sou hi-hat la (youn sou tan an, de sou & ak “a”), llamador a sou 2 ak 4. Mizisyen yo mete gwo kès la sou chak tan, sou 2 ak 4, oswa an tumbao: isit la li rete sou tan an.
music_rep_padrep_cumbia_fingers: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat sou gwacharaka a. Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès, dwèt mitan goch sou rebò.
music_rep_padrep_dancehall_feel: 3+3+2 la separe ant gwo kès (1 ak “a” apre 1, 3 ak “a” apre 3) ak kès (& apre 2 ak apre 4).
music_rep_padrep_dembow_feel: Four on the floor ak kès la sou “a” apre 1, & apre 2, epi ankò.
music_rep_padrep_dilla_feel: Hi-hat ak swing sou yon gwo kès dwat, ak kès la ki vini anviwon 20 ms bonè: de feel an menm tan.
music_rep_padrep_disco_feel: Four on the floor, kès la sou 2 ak 4, hi-hat an doub kwòch ki louvri sou chak &.
music_rep_padrep_disco_fingers: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat sou hi-hat la, dwèt mitan an louvri l sou &; dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès, dwèt mitan goch sou kès.
music_rep_padrep_dnb_feel: Gwo kès sou 1 ak & apre 3, kès sou 2 ak 4, vit.
music_rep_padrep_eighth_hats_feel: Backbeat la ak hi-hat an kwòch sou li.
music_rep_padrep_fill_one_beat_feel: Twa mezi rock, epi kat doub kwòch kès sou tan 4 la, epi tounen sou 1.
music_rep_padrep_fill_one_beat_fingers: Fill: altène de dwèt jouda yo sou kès la.
music_rep_padrep_fill_one_beat_label: Groove ak yon fill yon tan
music_rep_padrep_fill_two_beats_feel: Doub kwòch k ap desann batri a: kès, tom wo, tom mitan ak tom ba, epi premye tan an.
music_rep_padrep_fill_two_beats_fingers: Altène men yo, men dwat la an premye, sou pad yo de goch a dwat.
music_rep_padrep_fill_two_beats_label: Groove ak yon fill de tan
music_rep_padrep_fingers_hats_ghosts: Men dwat sou hi-hat la. Dwèt jouda goch sou kès la ak nòt fantom yo, dwèt mitan goch sou gwo kès la.
music_rep_padrep_fingers_kick_clap: Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès la, dwèt jouda dwat sou klap la.
music_rep_padrep_fingers_kick_rim_hats: Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès la, dwèt mitan goch sou rebò a, men dwat sou hi-hat la.
music_rep_padrep_fingers_kick_snare: Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès la, dwèt jouda dwat sou kès la.
music_rep_padrep_fingers_sixteenths_ghos: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat jwe doub kwòch yo sou hi-hat la youn apre lòt. Dwèt jouda goch sou kès la ak nòt fantom yo, dwèt mitan goch sou gwo kès la.
music_rep_padrep_fingers_split: Men dwat sou hi-hat la (dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan youn apre lòt). Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès ak kès.
music_rep_padrep_five_four_feel: Senk tan an 3 + 2: gwo kès la kòmanse chak gwoup sou 1 ak 4 (ak yon pouse sou & apre 2), kès la fèmen yo sou 3 ak 5.
music_rep_padrep_fool_in_the_rain_feel: Shuffle half-time John Bonham nan sou yon griy triyolè doub kwòch (sis pa pou chak tan). Hi-hat an shuffle, nòt fantom nan twou yo, backbeat la sou 3. Pwovizwa: yon vèsyon pou aprann, konpare l ak anrejistreman an.
music_rep_padrep_four_on_floor_feel: Yon gwo kès sou chak tan, klap la sou 2 ak 4.
music_rep_padrep_funk_150_feel: Tamborzão a akselere rive 150 BPM (depi 2016), ak gwo kès anplis DJ Sany Pitbull la sou & apre 3.
music_rep_padrep_funk_150_fingers: Menm jan ak tamborzão a, pi lejè sou dwèt yo.
music_rep_padrep_funk_sixteenths_feel: Hi-hat an doub kwòch sou yon gwo kès sou 1, “a” apre 1 ak & apre 3. Nòt fantom sou “a” apre 2 ak “a” apre 4.
music_rep_padrep_funky_drummer_feel: Hi-hat an doub kwòch, nòt fantom kès otou backbeat yo, hi-hat louvri sou “a” apre 2 ak apre 4.
music_rep_padrep_funky_drummer_fingers: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat jwe hi-hat la youn apre lòt. Dwèt jouda goch sou kès la ak nòt fantom li yo, dwèt mitan goch sou gwo kès la.
music_rep_padrep_ghost_boom_bap_feel: Nòt fantom sou “a” apre 2, “e” apre 3 ak “a” apre 4: dousman, anba 40% backbeat la.
music_rep_padrep_house_feel: Hi-hat fèmen sou tan an, hi-hat louvri sou chak &; gwo kès la pa janm kanpe.
music_rep_padrep_house_fingers: Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès la, dwèt mitan goch sou klap la, dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat sou de hi-hat yo.
music_rep_padrep_impeach_feel: De gwo kès ansanm sou & apre 2 ak 3, epi yon hi-hat louvri.
music_rep_padrep_independence_feel: Hi-hat la pa janm chanje. Gwo kès la pran yon nouvo modèl chak mezi.
music_rep_padrep_independence_label: Kat gwo kès anba yon sèl hi-hat
music_rep_padrep_kompa_feel: Klòch la se metwonòm konpa a, gong lan (yon tom atè ki toufe) sou 4. Pwovizwa: notasyon yon mizisyen gwoup, tempo a pa dokimante.
music_rep_padrep_kompa_fingers: Dwèt jouda dwat sou klòch la, dwèt mitan dwat sou hi-hat la. Dwèt jouda goch sou tom atè a.
music_rep_padrep_levee_feel: Dousman e lou. Gwo kès sou “a” apre 2 a se sipriz la.
music_rep_padrep_level1_summary: Gwo kès, kès ak hi-hat an kwòch, de men yo separe.
music_rep_padrep_level2_summary: Beat hip-hop de mezi ak gwo kès la k ap deplase.
music_rep_padrep_level2_title: Boom bap ak premye break yo
music_rep_padrep_level3_summary: Kès dousman ant backbeat yo, sou hi-hat an doub kwòch.
music_rep_padrep_level4_summary: Hi-hat ki fiks sou yon gwo kès k ap deplase, fill ak swing MPC.
music_rep_padrep_level5_summary: House, woulman trap, drum and bass.
music_rep_padrep_level6_summary: Break Amen ak Apache, mezi pa mezi.
music_rep_padrep_level7_summary: Griy triyolè a: shuffle blues ak half-time, ride swing la, 12/8.
music_rep_padrep_level8_summary: Groove an 5/4, 7/4 ak 7/8, konte an gwoup de ak twa.
music_rep_padrep_linear_3_over_4_feel: Hi-hat, kès, gwo kès, youn apre lòt an gwoup twa sou yon mezi kat tan: janm de kou ansanm.
music_rep_padrep_linear_3_over_4_fingers: Dwèt jouda dwat sou hi-hat, dwèt mitan dwat sou kès, dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès.
music_rep_padrep_linear_doubles_feel: R R L L: kou doub separe ant hi-hat ak nòt fantom kès, gwo kès la sou 1 ak & apre 3.
music_rep_padrep_linear_doubles_fingers: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat sou hi-hat la, dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan goch sou nòt fantom yo. Gwo kès la ak dwèt bag goch.
music_rep_padrep_linear_inverted_feel: R L L R L R R L: kou doub yo deplase anndan gwoup la, gwo kès la pran kou men goch sou & apre 3.
music_rep_padrep_linear_inverted_fingers: Men dwat sou hi-hat la, men goch sou kès la, gwo kès la kote men goch ta jwe & apre 3.
music_rep_padrep_linear_paradiddle_feel: R L R R L R L L: paradiddle la, backbeat la sou kou men goch, gwo kès la sou premye kou men dwat.
music_rep_padrep_linear_paradiddle_finge: Men dwat sou hi-hat la, men goch sou kès la, gwo kès la pou premye kou men dwat nan chak gwoup.
music_rep_padrep_linear_singles_feel: R L R L: kou men dwat yo sou hi-hat la ak backbeat la, kou men goch yo an nòt fantom, gwo kès la nan plas men dwat sou 1 ak 3.
music_rep_padrep_linear_singles_fingers: Dwèt jouda dwat sou hi-hat ak backbeat, dwèt jouda goch sou nòt fantom yo, dwèt mitan goch sou gwo kès la.
music_rep_padrep_one_beat_fill_feel: Yon mezi groove, kat doub kwòch sou kès la nan dènye tan li, epi crash ak gwo kès ansanm sou en an.
music_rep_padrep_one_beat_fill_fingers: Men dwat sou hi-hat la ak fill la, dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès. Ateri sou crash la ak men dwat.
music_rep_padrep_one_drop_feel: Anyen sou 1: gwo kès ak cross-stick tonbe ansanm sou 3 nan yon mezi half time, yon hi-hat louvri mennen nan pwochen an. Yo jwe l souvan ak yon shuffle.
music_rep_padrep_paradiddle_split_feel: RLRR LRLL ak men dwat sou kès la ak men goch sou hi-hat la: yon sticking ki sonnen tankou yon groove.
music_rep_padrep_paradiddle_split_finger: Dwèt jouda dwat sou kès la, dwèt jouda goch sou hi-hat la.
music_rep_padrep_purdie_feel: Shuffle half-time Bernard Purdie a: nòt fantom sou triyolè nan mitan an, backbeat la sou 3, gwo kès la sou 1 ak dènye triyolè 2 ak 4. Tempo apeprè.
music_rep_padrep_reggaeton_feel: Dembow la: yon gwo kès sou chak tan, 3+3+2 kès la sou li, yon tom ba sou 1 ak 3.
music_rep_padrep_reggaeton_fingers: Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès la, dwèt jouda dwat sou kès la, dwèt mitan goch sou tom nan, dwèt mitan dwat sou hi-hat la.
music_rep_padrep_rock_open_hat_feel: Rock debaz ak hi-hat la louvri sou & apre 4 epi fèmen ak premye hi-hat pwochen mezi a: elan ki mennen nan chak mezi.
music_rep_padrep_rock_open_hat_fingers: Dwèt jouda dwat sou hi-hat fèmen an, dwèt mitan dwat sou sa ki louvri a. Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès ak kès.
music_rep_padrep_rosanna_feel: Shuffle half-time Jeff Porcaro a, ki bati sou pa Purdie a. Nòt fantom sou triyolè nan mitan yo, backbeat la sou 3, yon gwo kès ki reponn tèt li sou de mezi. Pwovizwa: yon vèsyon pou aprann, konpare l ak anrejistreman an.
music_rep_padrep_rumba_clave_feel: Klav son an ak twazyèm nòt li yon doub kwòch pi ta: panche rumba a.
music_rep_padrep_rumba_clave_fingers: Dwèt jouda dwat sou rebò a.
music_rep_padrep_samba_feel: Sourdo a sou gwo kès la (premye ak dènye doub kwòch chak tan), yon liy hi-hat ki chaje ak pedal hi-hat la sou chak &. Tempo apeprè.
music_rep_padrep_samba_fingers: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan goch sou figi gwo kès la, men dwat sou hi-hat la, dwèt bag goch sou pedal hi-hat la.
music_rep_padrep_seven_eight_feel: Sèt kwòch an 2 + 2 + 3, klik la sou chak kwòch: gwo kès sou 1, kès sou 3, gwo kès sou 5, kès sou 6.
music_rep_padrep_seven_four_feel: Sèt tan an 4 + 3. Gwo kès ak kès altène, kidonk yon mezi fini sou yon gwo kès epi pwochen an kòmanse sou yon lòt. Ti bite sa a fè 7 la santi l tankou 7.
music_rep_padrep_shave_tag_feel: Shave and a haircut, two bits: fen vodvil la (Charles Hale, 1899) tout batè jwe pou fèmen yon mizik.
music_rep_padrep_shave_tag_fingers: Men dwat travèse kès la ak tom yo, dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès anba dènye crash la.
music_rep_padrep_shuffle_ghosts_feel: Shuffle blues la ak yon nòt fantom kès sou twazyèm triyolè 1 ak 3, ki mennen nan chak backbeat. Kenbe nòt fantom yo anba 40%.
music_rep_padrep_slow_blues_feel: Douz kwòch pa mezi, klik la chak twa: gwo kès sou 1 ak 3, kès sou 2 ak 4, hi-hat la sou chak kwòch.
music_rep_padrep_snare_build_feel: Nwa, epi kwòch, epi de mezi doub kwòch sou yon four on the floor, ak crash la sou drop la.
music_rep_padrep_snare_build_fingers: Altène dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat sou kès la. Dwèt jouda goch kenbe gwo kès la.
music_rep_padrep_soca_feel: Four on the floor ak kès la an 3+3+2 ak yon hi-hat louvri k ap griye sou chak &. (Pwofesè yo chanje hi-hat la: sa a se vèsyon Boston Drum Lessons.)
music_rep_padrep_soca_fingers: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat sou hi-hat la, louvri l sou &; dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès, dwèt mitan goch sou kès.
music_rep_padrep_son_clave_feel: Twa epi de: ritm mizik kiben, salsa ak beat Bo Diddley a apiye sou li.
music_rep_padrep_son_clave_fingers: Dwèt jouda dwat sou rebò a. Konte doub kwòch yo tou ba.
music_rep_padrep_songo_feel: Songo kiben: klòch la sou tan an, gwo kès la sou & apre 2 ak sou 4 tankou tumbao bas la. Kès la pale otou yo, ak tom ba a sou 4 ak & li. Pwovizwa: yon vèsyon pou aprann pami anpil.
music_rep_padrep_songo_fingers: Dwèt jouda dwat sou klòch la. Dwèt jouda goch sou kès la, dwèt mitan goch sou gwo kès la, dwèt mitan dwat sou tom nan.
music_rep_padrep_steppers_feel: Yon gwo kès sou chak tan anba cross-stick la sou 3: beat reggae k ap mache a.
music_rep_padrep_stomp_clap_feel: De kout pye ak yon klap, pi ansyen ritm foul moun konnen.
music_rep_padrep_swing_56_feel: Chak dezyèm doub kwòch yon ti kras an reta: lib, men se pa yon shuffle toujou.
music_rep_padrep_swing_56_fingers: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat jwe hi-hat la youn apre lòt, dwèt mitan an yon ti kras an reta.
music_rep_padrep_swing_62_feel: Pi pre triyolè a: balans hip-hop la.
music_rep_padrep_swing_62_fingers: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat jwe hi-hat la youn apre lòt. Santi sa ki an reta a, pa konte l.
music_rep_padrep_swing_ride_feel: Ding, ding-a ding, ding-a: ride la sou chak tan ak dènye triyolè 2 ak 4. Pye hi-hat la sou 2 ak 4, gwo kès la tou dousman sou chak tan.
music_rep_padrep_swing_ride_fingers: Dwèt jouda dwat sou ride la. Dwèt jouda goch sou pedal hi-hat la, dwèt mitan goch sou gwo kès la, dousman.
music_rep_padrep_syncopated_feel: Yon gwo kès ki pa sou tan an.
music_rep_padrep_tamborzao_feel: “Tum pa-pá pum pá”: yon tresillo po tanbou (1, “a” apre 1, & apre 2) ki jwenn repons sou 3 ak 4, san hi-hat, san kès. Rediksyon DJ Luciano Oliveira li menm.
music_rep_padrep_tamborzao_fingers: Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès la ak tom anlè a, dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat sou konga a (tom wo), dwèt mitan goch sou tom atè a.
music_rep_padrep_think_feel: Break “Yeah! Woo!” la: yon gwo kès, kès la sou 2 ak 4, nòt fantom sou “a” apre 2 ak & apre 3. Doub kwòch yo (yon tanbouren sou anrejistreman an) chita yon ti kras dèyè tan an.
music_rep_padrep_tony_allen_feel: Batè Fela a: gwo kès pa pè, yon liy kès pou kont li, men an sou hi-hat la ak pye a sou pedal hi-hat la, tout endepandan. Tempo apeprè.
music_rep_padrep_tony_allen_fingers: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat sou hi-hat la, dwèt jouda goch sou kès la, dwèt mitan goch sou gwo kès la, dwèt bag goch sou pedal hi-hat la. Aprann li an mòd Wait anvan.
music_rep_padrep_trap_32_feel: Half time: klap la sou 3. Dènye tan hi-hat la woule an trip kwòch.
music_rep_padrep_trap_32_fingers: Woulman an: dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat fè yon woulman de dwèt sou yon pad (oswa kenbe Note Repeat sou 1/32).
music_rep_padrep_trap_triplet_feel: Menm beat la, woulman an an triyolè doub kwòch (1/16T).
music_rep_padrep_trap_triplet_fingers: Woulman de dwèt, sis pa tan.
music_rep_padrep_tresillo_backbeat_feel: Twa-twa-de nan gwo kès la kont kès la sou 2 ak 4: rasin reggaeton, New Orleans ak yon bon pati nan pop.
music_rep_padrep_turnaround_fill_feel: Twa mezi ak yon fill ki fè fraz la vire.
music_rep_padrep_zouk_feel: Hi-hat an doub kwòch, fò ak dousman. Senkiyo tibwa a sou rebò a. Kès sèlman sou 2 ak 4.
music_rep_padrep_zouk_fingers: Dwèt jouda ak dwèt mitan dwat sou hi-hat la (dwèt jouda fò, dwèt mitan dousman). Dwèt jouda goch sou gwo kès, dwèt mitan goch sou kès, dwèt bag goch sou rebò.
music_rep_padskills_dyn_crescendo: Crescendo: yon mezi doub kwòch, soti dousman rive fò
music_rep_padskills_dyn_even: Egal: sèz kou nan menm nivo
music_rep_padskills_dyn_ladder: Kat nivo: kat kou chak, soti dousman rive fò
music_rep_padskills_fill_down_toms: Doub kwòch k ap desann sou tom yo sou 3 ak 4
music_rep_padskills_fill_snare_eighths: Kwòch sou kès la sou 3 ak 4
music_rep_padskills_fill_triplet_toms: Triyolè k ap desann sou tom yo (shuffle)
music_rep_padskills_fill_whole_bar: Yon mezi doub kwòch sou tout batri a
music_rep_padskills_interp_kick: Gwo kès la li, anba hi-hat la
music_rep_padskills_interp_snare: Kès la li, anlè hi-hat la
music_rep_padskills_line_clave: Clave son an kenbe, gwo kès la ap bouje
music_rep_padskills_orch_hats_snare_deta: Men dwat sou hi-hat la, men goch sou kès la, gwo kès anba aksan yo
music_rep_padskills_orch_ride_snare_deta: Men dwat sou ride la, men goch sou kès la, gwo kès anba aksan yo
music_rep_padskills_orch_toms_lead_detai: Premye kou chak gwoup sou yon tom, rès la sou hi-hat ak kès
music_rep_phrases_source_bach_suite_no_2: Bach, Swit n° 2 BWV 1067 (anviwon 1738), yon kent pi ba, an E minè
music_rep_phrases_source_bizet_1867_suit: Bizet (1867, swit 1879), yon oktav pi ba
music_rep_phrases_source_bizet_1872_the_: Bizet (1872), pati alto a jan li enprime a
music_rep_phrases_source_gluck_1774_a_fi: Gluck (1774), yon kent pi ba, an Bb
music_rep_phrases_source_grieg_1888_flut: Grieg (1888), flit I, yon oktav pi ba
music_rep_phrases_source_joplin_1899_at_: Joplin (1899), nan wotè reyèl li, an Ab

music_rep_phrases_title_d_minor_lick_6_o: Lick D minè 6: sou vamp Dm ak G a

music_rep_phrases_user_why: Anrejistre depi {from}. Mennen l nan tout tonalite yo.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_arlesien: Solo pou flit ak ap tout flitis konnen an.
Premye solo saksofòn ki te vin popilè nan òkès, wo epi k ap chante.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_au_clair: Senk nòt, valè long: yon mizik pou kontwole souf ou.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_badineri: Mòso pou flitis yo montre talan yo ak pou odisyon: doub kwòch byen pwòp, a de tan.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_bebop_en: Teknik santral bebop la: antoure nòt ou vize a pa anwo ak pa anba, epi tonbe sou li.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_blessed_: Minyè dous flitis yo aprann bonè a: liy long sou yon sèl souf.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_bolero: Kresendo ki pi popilè a. Saksofòn tenò ak sopranò yo pran tèm nan.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_bumblebe: Pasaj kwomatik tout moun rekonèt la, nan vitès pratik.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_c_blues_: Gam blues la soti anwo, epi tyès minè a k ap pliye rive nan majè a.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_e_minor_: Monte pentatonik la epi tounen: fòm ki dèyè pifò liy saks rock ak pop.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_entertai: Fraz ragtime tout moun konnen an, soti nan pwòp edisyon Joplin 1902 a.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_g_blues_: Premye vokabilè pou enpwovize sou enstriman van an: blue note la epi tounen.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_honk_rif: Gwo son ba sou tonik la, sèt bemòl la anba yo, ak tyès blue a: son saks k ap mache sou kontwa ba a.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_hot_cros: Premye mizik saksofòn nan: B, A ak G ak men gòch la sèlman.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_ii_v_i: Monte Dm7, desann G7, epi F ak D# k ap fèmen sou E: yon fraz bebop konplè.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_lightly_: Youn nan premye mizik liv fanfa yo: desann men gòch la epi monte ankò.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_maple_le: Rag ki fè ragtime egziste a: fòmil k ap sote nan kòmansman an.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_morning_: Melodi flit moun plis konnen nan òkès la: solèy leve nan Peer Gynt.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_ode_to_j: Klasik liv fanfa yo, an G.
music_rep_phrases_why_aerophone_old_cast: Plent saksofòn alto a nan Tablo yon egzibisyon.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_a_blues_lic: Monte rive sou rasin nan epi desann nan bwat la ankò: premye lick pou w metrize.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_add9_moves: G, Cadd9, Dsus4 ak Em7 ak dwèt bag la ak ti dwèt la ki rete fiks sou kòd 2 ak 1 nan frèt 3: chanjman pop akoustik la.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_amazing_gra: Premye melodi a twa tan, sou kòd lib yo.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_blues_scale: Bwat 1 monte epi desann soti nan A ki ba a, ak E bemòl la ant D ak E: blue note an pasan.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_blues_turna: Doub kòd k ap desann sou yon A ki kenbe, ki fini tout blues douz mezi.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_boogie_shuf: Kent lan k ap balanse sou sizyèm nan sou kòd ki ba yo: premye riff ritmik la.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_boom_chuck: Nòt bas, grate, nòt bas, grate: premye modèl pikin ak grate.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_d_dorian_ru: D doryen soti nan D rive nan D yon oktav pi wo, an kwòch, epi rete sou nòt anwo a.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_d_dorian_si: Monte rive sou B natirèl, nòt ki fè D minè vin doryen an, epi desann nòt pa nòt rive sou D.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_d_dorian_va: B ak D desine akò G vamp lan, epi E tonbe sou D: doryen an tande tankou nòt akò a.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_d_minor_ans: Monte rive sou D epi tounen, epi menm ritm lan reponn pi ba, pou fini sou rasin nan.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_d_minor_lon: Kenbe D ki wo a, desann nan bwat la, kenbe A a: kite nòt la chante anvan ou deplase.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_d_minor_oct: D, C ak A, chak ak oktav li de kòd pi wo: yon liy epè k ap chante ak de nòt.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_double_stop: De kòd nan senkyèm frèt la, frape an kwòch, epi k ap desann: entwodiksyon tout rock and roll pataje.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_g_run: Pasaj yo plis jwe nan bluegrass, siyati nan fen yon fraz.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_hammer_on_c: Grate akò a ak yon dwèt ki toujou leve, epi frape l desann: dekorasyon gitaris soul ak rock mete sou Am, C, Em ak D.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_minor_third: Tyès minè a k ap fwote ak rasin nan sou kòd G ak D, de fwa, epi lakay.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_ode_to_joy: Premye melodi nan pifò metòd pozisyon ouvè.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_pentatonic_: Modèl 1 nan senkyèm frèt la, bwat tout gitaris solo kòmanse ladan l.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_root_b7_5: A, G, E soti anwo nan bwat 1, de fwa, epi desann rive sou A ki ba a: fòm san lick blues.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_shave_hairc: Fen tout moun konnen an: two bits.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_spanish_rom: Premye mòso klasik tout moun aprann. Men melodi li sou kòd ki pi wo a.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_sus_to_majo: Dsus4, D, Dsus2, D, epi menm bagay la sou A: yon dwèt k ap leve epi poze sou kòd ki wo yo pandan akò a ap sonnen.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_texas_shuff: Boogie sou kòd ki ba yo, lonje rive 5, 6, sèt bemòl, 6 nan yon shuffle long-kout byen fò, sou E, A, E ak B: motè blues Texas la. Yon klik pou chak nwa pwente.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_travis_c_am: Premye modèl fingerpicking pou kòmanse: pous la sou bas la, dwèt yo ant yo.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_twinkle: Yon premye melodi sou de kòd ki pi wo yo.
music_rep_phrases_why_guitar_walking_boo: Riff ritmik yon sèl nòt anba yon blues douz mezi, sou A epi sou D.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_alberti: Fòmil men gòch ki anba mwatye mizik Mozart ak Haydn.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_amen_ending: Kadans plagal sou yon tonik ki kenbe, ak kat minè a sou wout tounen lakay: amèn nan fen yon kantik oswa yon mizik gospel.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_blues_ending: Liy anwo a desann soti nan rasin nan rive nan kent lan sou bas la, epi akò sèt II bemòl la tonbe sou tonik la: se konsa yon blues di orevwa.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_blues_shuffl: Kent ak sizyèm k ap balanse anba yon blues douz mezi: men gòch tout pyanis blues, sou C epi sou F.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_blues_turnar: I, I7, IV, IV dyèz dimine, I, VI7, ii, V7: kat dènye mezi yon blues, men gòch la ap monte anba yo.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_boogie_bass: Premye groove men gòch nan metòd blues ak jazz yo: monte akò a epi tounen, epi menm bagay la sou IV.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_c_blues_lick: Premye vokabilè pou enpwovize: monte gam blues la epi tounen lakay.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_canon_chords: Uit akò Pachelbel yo, pwogresyon moun plis prete a, yon akò pou chak tan.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_fill_grace_s: Yon glise rapid soti nan tyès bemòl la rive nan tyès la, epi kent lan, epi lakay: nòt kraze pyano blues ak pop la.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_fill_octave_: Oktav k ap monte 5, 6, 7 rive sou tonik la nan pwochen premye tan an: anakrouz ki leve yon balad pou mennen l nan pwochen fraz li.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_fill_pentato: Yon pasaj pentatonik majè an doub kwòch soti anwo, ki ranpli mezi a anvan pwochen fraz la tonbe sou akò a.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_fur_elise: Mizik moun plis mande lè ou fin konn baz yo.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_gospel_653: Sis, senk, twa, epi ankò yon oktav pi ba, pou tonbe sou akò a: pasaj gospel moun itilize plis la.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_gospel_octav: Men dwat la balanse ant pous la ak ti dwèt la, yon oktav apa, pou kenbe nòt anwo a, epi li tonbe sou akò a.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_gospel_penta: Desann pentatonik majè a ak yon nòt dekorasyon anvan chak tyès: pasaj yon pyanis gospel mete ant fraz yo.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_greensleeves: Mòso referans lan nan tonalite minè, a twa tan.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_happy_birthd: Y ap mande w jwe l.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_i_vi_iv_v: Kat akò ki anba mil chante, ak voicing sere pou men an pa bouje twòp.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_jingle_bells: Mizik sezon fèt tout moun mande a.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_mountain_kin: Bouk ki monte tou dousman an: menm liy lan, pi vit chak fwa.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_nachtmusik: Tout moun rekonèt li touswit: yon apèj G majè k ap monte, ak repons li.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_ode_to_joy: Yon klasik premye mwa nan tout metòd: sèlman nòt ki youn bò lòt, yon ritm pwente.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_rock_octave_: Oktav men dwat k ap desann gam majè a an kwòch, pou tonbe sou akò a: gwo fill yon balad rock.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_rock_triplet: Men dwat la frape yon akò an triolè pandan men gòch la ap mache yon boogie: pyano rock and roll ane 1950 yo. Ekri an 12/8, yon klik pou chak gwoup twa.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_rock_turn_wa: Yon gruppetto otou kent lan ki tonbe sou rasin nan an 3/4, fill men dwat yon vals pyano-ba, epi akò a.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_seven_three_: Sis rasin youn kent apa ki mache tounen lakay, men dwat la deplase yon nòt oswa de chak fwa: turnaround ki anba fen mizik gospel ak soul.
music_rep_phrases_why_piano_twinkle: Premye mizik tout moun aprann: senk dwèt, yon sèl pozisyon men.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_amazing_gr: Yon melodi dousman a twa tan, tout nan premye pozisyon.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_blues_doub: De kòd ansanm, G ak C rive E ak A, epi yon ti mache rive sou A.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_blues_pent: Desann pentatonik A minè a soti nan D rive nan C, pou tonbe sou A: premye lick blues sou ukulele.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_blues_turn: Yon A wo sou yon liy k ap desann sou kòd C, epi A rive E7: fen tout blues douz mezi.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_campanella: Kòd G ak A lib yo sonnen anba gam nan: son klè k ap sonnen ansanm nan fingerstyle ak G wo a.
Senk nòt, chak sou yon lòt kòd, pou yo tout ka sonnen: gam ki dèyè Cripple Creek.
Gam minè an campanella nivo ki pi wo yo: B bemòl ak D sou kòd G, C dyèz sou kòd A.
Nòt vwazen sou kòd vwazen: F sonnen anba E, G anba A.
Premye mizik la ankò, ak G ak A sou kòd deyò yo ki lib pou yo ka sonnen.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_chord_melo: Nòt melodi a anwo chak fòm akò, nòt apa ant yo: premye aranjman melodi ak akò.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_four_chord: Kat premye akò ukulele yo, de tan chak.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_happy_birt: Y ap mande w jwe l, sou kòd G re-antran an.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_hawaiian_v: D7, G7, C: entwodiksyon ak fen klasik yon mizik awayen.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_island_str: Desann, desann-monte, monte-desann-monte: grate ki se siyati ukulele a, sou yon sèl akò.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_mary: Yon klasik nan liv metòd yo: twa nòt, epi de lòt ankò.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_ode_to_joy: Tout nan premye pozisyon sou kòd C ak E.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_oh_susanna: Mizik bò dife a: anakrouz rapid ak yon ritm pwente.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_picking_c_: Premye modèl pikin nan: pous la sou kòd G, dwèt yo sou lòt kòd yo.
music_rep_phrases_why_ukulele_saints: Premye chante nan anpil liv ukulele.
music_rep_rhythm_ear_dotted_sixteenths: Ajoute kwòch pwente ak doub kwòch
music_rep_rhythm_groove_sixteenths: Gwo kès an doub kwòch ak nòt fantom sou kès la
music_rep_rhythm_groove_trap: Trap: kès la sou 3, 808 la ozalantou l
music_rep_score_improv_game_approach_abo: Yon nòt akò sou chak tan 1, ou rive sou li pa yon demi ton anba oswa anwo. Pwen an se pòsyon mezi yo.
music_rep_score_improv_game_blues_scale_: Sèlman gam blues tonalite a (1, b3, 4, b5, 5, b7). Pwen an se pòsyon nòt ki ladan l.
music_rep_score_improv_game_bridge_about: Poze oswa jwe tèm nan nan seksyon A yo epi enpwovize sèlman sou pon an, ak yon tyès oswa yon sèt mwens pase yon tan apre chanjman an, pou 85% chanjman l yo. Chwazi yon mizik ki gen yon pon (rhythm changes, Satin Doll).
music_rep_score_improv_game_call_respons: Gwoup la jwe yon apèl de mezi, ou reponn nan de mezi ki vin apre yo. Chak repons kòmanse nan mezi pa l yo epi fini anvan pwochen apèl la.
music_rep_score_improv_game_changes_abou: Nòt akò sou 75% tan 1 ak 3 yo, ak yon tyès oswa yon sèt mwens pase yon tan apre chanjman an, pou 70% chanjman yo.
music_rep_score_improv_game_chord_tones_: Liy sou chanjman akò yo ak yon nòt akò sou chak tan 1 ak 3. Pwen an se pòsyon tan ki genyen youn.
music_rep_score_improv_game_displacement: Yon ti motif de a sis nòt, chak fwa yon tan pita nan mezi a (lide Straight, No Chaser la). Objektif la se yon motif deplase nan de mezi sou chak twa.
music_rep_score_improv_game_free_about: Enpwovize jan ou vle. Nou konte nòt akò sou tan 1 ak 3, yon tyès oswa yon sèt sou chak chanjman akò, tan sou griy ritm lan ak yon poz chak kat mezi.
music_rep_score_improv_game_guide_tones_: Jwe sèlman tyès ak sèt, youn oswa de pa mezi, epi ateri sou youn mwens pase yon tan apre chanjman an, pou 80% chanjman yo.
music_rep_score_improv_game_melody_fills: Jwe tèm nan, epi ranpli sèlman poz li yo ki dire de tan oswa plis ak de a kat nòt: 90% nòt melodi a, ak yon fill nan sis poz (nan chak poz, si li gen mwens). Ou bezwen youn nan patisyon ou yo ak melodi li.
music_rep_score_improv_game_motif_about: Kenbe ritm yon mezi (riff C Jam nan, oswa Charleston lan) epi chanje nòt yo pou yo mache ak chak akò: menm ritm lan nan 8 mezi sou 12, yon nòt akò sou tan 1 nan 75% ladan yo.
music_rep_score_improv_game_off_beat_abo: Kòmanse chak fraz sou kontretan, sou « e » 1 an oswa « e » 4 a. Pwen an se pòsyon fraz ki fè l.
music_rep_score_improv_game_pentatonic_1: Sèlman pantatonik minè sou tonik tonalite a (pantatonik minè D sou D doryen).
music_rep_score_improv_game_pentatonic_2: Sèlman pantatonik minè yon ton pi wo pase tonik la (pantatonik minè E sou D doryen).
music_rep_score_improv_game_pentatonic_5: Sèlman pantatonik minè yon kent pi wo pase tonik la (pantatonik minè A sou D doryen).
music_rep_score_improv_game_quote_about: Louvri chak seksyon A ak yon moso nan melodi mizik la (kat nòt oswa plis, nan nenpòt oktav), epi devlope l. Ou bezwen youn nan patisyon ou yo ak melodi li.
music_rep_score_improv_game_side_slip_ab: Glise yon fraz yon demi ton pi wo (twa nòt oswa plis andeyò gam lan) pandan anviwon de tan, epi rezoud sou yon nòt akò nan tan ki vin apre a. Kat side-slip pa chorus, yo tout rezoud.
music_rep_score_improv_game_space: De mezi jwe, de mezi poz
music_rep_score_improv_game_space_1: Yon mezi jwe, yon mezi poz
music_rep_score_improv_game_space_1_abou: Jwe yon mezi, poze yon mezi, pandan tout chorus la. Pwen an se pòsyon mezi ou respekte.
music_rep_score_improv_game_space_about: Jwe de mezi, poze de mezi, pandan tout chorus la. Pwen an se pòsyon mezi ou respekte.
music_rep_score_improv_game_thirds_about: Ateri sou tyès chak nouvo akò, mwens pase yon tan apre chanjman an. Pwen an se pòsyon chanjman ou reyisi.
music_rep_score_improv_game_three_notes_: Sèlman 1, b3 ak 5 tonalite a (F, Ab, C an F), 90% nòt ou yo, ak omwen sis poz de tan pa chorus.
